items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: And the same day I got the drums, Johnny Pernodon needed a drummer. ... That was my first job.

ctx.x: Did he start out about the same time as you?

No, I think after me, you know. He came after me. After me. My first job was with, remember Johnny Pernodon? Yeah. When I was working at Sancho Hotel. That's right. And I saved that money. My mom told me to take that $25 and pay on a set of drums. Yeah. And the same day I got the drums, Johnny Pernodon needed a drummer. Uh-huh. And they came by the house in Harvard. That was my first job. We played for some campaign down on the Center Rock and Charter. By a bar. I mean, political thing, you know what I mean?
He used to break all the scenes out of my mother's chairs. Playing drums.
